scope: Explicitly reviewed ranked/Flat Rules opponent team in Battle 12; no automatic applicability to other formats

sources.license: Official Pokémon notice; attribution/link, local review only

official_rule: No two participating Pokémon may have the same held item.
exceptions: none is absence of an item and has unlimited capacity
Showdown Champions standarddraft explicitly disables Item Clause; random doubles does not inherit Flat Rules. Do not generalize.
semantics: All-different original identities within (battle_id, side); consumption/removal/transfer/replacement/restoration change current possession, not original assignment. Current possession alone cannot reserve original ownership.
applicability_basis: User specifies applicable Champions team-building rules; official M-C and pinned Flat Rules corroborate clause. No assertion that historical recording date is proven M-C.
